task: Generate only the four orthographic lateral edge views for each of two source-matched floor transition tiles.
layout: 4 columns by 2 rows, transparent background. Columns exactly FRONT, RIGHT, LEFT, REAR. Row 1: industrial brick corner transition. Row 2: industrial brick edge transition. Each cell contains exactly one complete view; no lettering, cell lines, cast shadows or neighboring fragments.
camera: True axis-aligned principal elevations, zero isometric or three-quarter angle. These are horizontal floor tiles. FRONT/RIGHT/LEFT/REAR show only a very shallow vertical masonry edge, never the broad top plane. Keep identical slab Z height across every lateral view. Orthographic, fixed shared object scale and centered alignment.
identity: Match the supplied source tiles exactly: dark burnt-orange square brick pavers with dark mortar, irregular pale tan stone curb blocks, same warm material and age. The corner transition has an L-shaped raised pale-stone curb following the two arms visible in its source TOP; the edge transition has a single pale-stone curb along the source's right-hand long side only. Preserve curb sidedness from one fixed world orientation: opposite cameras must show the corresponding opposite end/profile rather than repeating a decorative face. Keep the orange paver slab low and horizontal.
negative: No upright walls, corner posts, extra raised blocks, stairs, furniture, props, floor background, perspective, visible top-face tile pattern in lateral views, changes to brick palette, rounded curb, or detached pieces.
output_quality: Readable small illustrated orthographic asset views; full silhouettes with generous transparent margins.
